data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a prior year strengthening of $0.967 million, calculated from the gross claims development triangle for the 2017 underwriting year. This adverse development is generally attributed to adverse claims development, though specific causes for this particular movement were not explicitly detailed. The syndicate primarily underwrites treaty reinsurance business, which would be the affected line of business.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle as no explicit narrative or movement note for prior year development was found. The exact reserve text for this calculation is not available as it was derived from the triangle. The claims development triangle only shows data for 2017, 2018, and 2019 underwriting years. The PYD calculation excludes the two most recent years (2018 and 2019), focusing only on 2017.
